## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement you would like to see added.

## Problem / Use Case
Is your feature request related to a problem or specific SAP security management workflow? (e.g. "I need to override role-transaction relationships directly in Coverage Analysis").

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you imagine this feature working or how the UI/backend should handle it.

## Alternative Options Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup screenshots, or SAP authorization details here.
